component: host memory signals (Mach VM statistics estimate and memorystatus pressure level)
modifications: Re-expressed estimateHostAvailableMemory's page arithmetic in Python (estimate_host_available_bytes); Python integers remove the overflow guards, the file-backed/purgeable underflow guards are kept.
Replaced the C++ Mach calls with ctypes host_page_size + host_statistics64(HOST_VM_INFO64) using the fixed rev1 structure prefix, and hw.memsize read once per process.

Polled kern.memorystatus_vm_pressure_level via sysctlbyname instead of Splash's dispatch memory-pressure source, and added a rise-immediately/fall-after-stable hysteresis monitor that Splash does not have.
Used the estimate only as the opt-in host term of mlx2's existing admission headroom, keeping mlx2's 20 GiB reserve and physical-footprint floor; no reservation/governor object was ported.
validation: tests/test_host_memory_signals.py (formula units, hysteresis with a fake clock, live Darwin cross-check against vm_stat and sysctl)
